scope: Explicit large dependencies of tracked work sources; not a manifest of all work or a backup receipt

artifacts.generation: In a fresh durable directory under proofs/ft1536/replay-work, run sage <absolute path to generator> with HOME, TMPDIR and caches under that directory. The generator embeds its numeric parameters and writes CountsFoldCertificate.lean in its current directory. Verify the file SHA256 before using it.
artifacts.verification_at_registration: SHA256 and size of existing source and generator only; no new generation or Lean replay

artifacts.generation: In a fresh durable directory, run sage <absolute path to generator> (mode test/bench/full) with HOME, TMPDIR and caches under that directory. The generator embeds its Cython engine source and compiles it (SageMath, Cython, GCC), writing radial_engine.cpython-314-x86_64-linux-gnu.so and engine_build_receipt.json in its repro directory. Verify the file SHA256 before using it.
artifacts.verification_at_registration: SHA256 and size of existing source and generator only; no new generation or Lean replay
